title: State v. Novembrino (N.J. 1987)
key_points: Holding: NJ does not recognize a good-faith exception to the exclusionary rule.
officer_notes: Scenario: A judge signs a warrant that later proves to lack probable cause; you relied on it in good faith.
Takeaway: Write strong, detailed affidavits; good faith won't save a weak warrant in NJ.
